title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Burglary Deductible Base When a Duplicate Payment Is Re-Settled
content:
**Clause.** When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim carrying a duplicate payment is re-settled, the deductible subtracted from the duplicate re-settlement total is taken from the duplicate re-settlement's deductible base. The duplicate re-settlement's deductible base is the level's deductible, except that for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has drive-up access it is 10 percent of the duplicate re-settlement total, and for a burglary claim on a unit whose class has no drive-up access it is 5 percent of that total, in both burglary situations never less than the level's deductible.

The peril is read from the claim as filed; drive-up access is a feature of the covered Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement's unit class.

**Cases (hypothetical, level deductible 100.00).**
- Burglary, drive-up class, total 2,700.00: 270.00.
- Burglary, interior class, total 2,700.00: 135.00.
- Burglary, interior class, total 1,400.00: 5 percent is 70.00, so 100.00.
- Vandalism, any class: 100.00.
